summary.text: An Idoma LGA in western Benue, on the border with the Igala LGAs of Kogi. Its people are mainly Idoma, with a few Igala.

history.text: Part of the ancient Idoma territories of the middle Benue valley; Idoma tradition calls Apa the home of those who made the first migration from the historic kingdom.

livelihoods.text: Farming: yams, cassava, maize, guinea corn and melons.
